item.title: Orion Scout
item.description: Why Orion exists Some environments call for a limited-purpose observer that can inspect unfamiliar or higher-risk surfaces without exposing a primary assistant or workflow. Orion Scout is designed for that narrower role: observe, collect signals, and return findings with supporting context. Operating pattern Deploy a fresh Scout instance into a controlled sandbox. Attach only the approved tools needed for the assignment. Observe prompts, flows, outputs, and environmental signals. Report findings into the Witness log with linked artifacts where appropriate.

item.title: Sentinel Gatekeeper
item.description: Core function Sentinel Gatekeeper sits at the trust boundary between systems and evaluates requested actions against explicit policies. When activity falls outside the approved lane, Gatekeeper can pause execution, annotate the record, and route the event for operator review. Operating principles Explainable enforcement. When an action is blocked or held, Gatekeeper records the relevant rule and the reason it applied. Measured intervention. Controls are designed to reduce risk without unnecessarily disrupting legitimate work.

item.title: Anne Flint
item.description: Role Anne Flint is the Sentinel Project’s Fair Witness AI: an agent designed to observe, qualify, and report what can be verified. Her purpose is straightforward: improve trust in human and machine workflows by separating observed facts from assumptions, speculation, and noise. What Anne does Anne supports teams that need disciplined handling of information, decisions, and records. Her work includes: Qualified observation — separating direct facts from unknowns Research and synthesis — organizing inputs into usable summaries Executive assistance — helping operators manage work with context and discretion Communication support — translating technical findings into clear language Fair Witness protocol When witness mode is engaged, Anne follows a strict reporting structure:
